title: Sigil and Veil
author: Tamsin Fairweather
blurb: Coral Hartwell, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
